title: Best Verbal Instruction to Obtain Voluntary Pelvic Floor Muscle Contraction
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the best verbal instruction to obtain a PFMC and to evaluate the understanding and acceptability of the proposed instructions.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Follow in neuro-urology
* Lower urinary tract symptoms

Exclusion Criteria:

* Can't speak French
study_population: Patients consulting in a tertiary center in neuro-urology.
